facts.fact: 这是活动协调员 Simone 的广播，她代表岛主 Mitch 和 Dianne Jones 夫妇欢迎各位小客人来到 Paradise 度假村的儿童区。
facts.anchor: On behalf of owners Mitch and Dianne Jones, I’d like to welcome all junior guests to your side of the Paradise Resort.

facts.fact: 小客人先入住各自别墅，父母则前往他们自己的私密住处。
facts.anchor: But first, it’s time for you to settle into your villas while your parents set off for their own private quarters.

facts.fact: 广播承诺：父母不在时若有需要，“你的愿望就是我们的命令”。
facts.anchor: If you need anything while they’re gone, don’t worry! Your wish is our command throughout your vacation.

facts.fact: 度假期间每天会收到名为 Hypes 的特别信息，通过最先进的扩音系统播报。
facts.anchor: Each day you’re here, you’ll receive special messages that we call Hypes.

facts.fact: Hypes 用来宣传仅限 Thrill Harbor 客人享用的景点、设施和短途游览，且儿童区全境都能听到。
facts.anchor: Hypes are meant to draw your attention to the special attractions, amenities, and excursions available only to our guests from Thrill Harbor.

facts.fact: 当下推荐的去处是 guest villas 正北方的 Iguana Beach，那里有多项冒险可以体验。
facts.anchor: In fact, there are several adventures to explore right now at Iguana Beach, just north of the guest villas.

facts.fact: Iguana Beach 可玩沿海岸滑浮胎、趸船游戏机上的复古电子游戏，还能拖伞看全岛美景。
facts.anchor: You can go tubing along the coastline, play vintage video games on the pontoon boat arcade, and go parasailing

facts.fact: 结尾号召：Paradise 的体验由你自己做主，走出去抓住每一个瞬间。
facts.anchor: Your experience in Paradise is up to you, so get out there and seize every moment!
